messages:
leo: Hey all, opening my first PR touching runtime + small docs change. Quick checklist: squash vs keep commits? branch prefix? any runtime-specific gotchas?

mai: Welcome! Develop with focused commits, but squash WIP before merge. Final commit should follow Conventional Commits (type(scope): summary).

sam: Branches: feature/<you>/short-desc, fix/<short-desc>, hotfix/<ticket>. Example: feature/leo/kv-cleanup.

leo: Any required local checks?

mai: Run `pre-commit run --all-files` and `pytest tests/unit -q`. Formatters: `black .` and `ruff format`. If touching perf, run `python perf/run.py --quick`.

sam: PR size: keep changes small (<~400 LOC) or split into prep + feature PRs. Add a How to test section in the PR.

ci-bot: redwood-ci: lint + tests + typecheck triggered for PR #401. https://ci.redwood.ai/build/401

leo: Where are CODEOWNERS and PR template?

mai: CODEOWNERS at .github/CODEOWNERS. PR template at .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md — it inserts checklist headings for What/Why/How to test/Rollout.

sam: If post-merge bug shows up, prefer patch-forward unless it impacts customer SLAs; then revert and notify eng-sre. For release fixes target release/<semver>-patch.

leo: Perfect, thanks — I'll run hooks and open a draft PR. Ping @mai for review when ready. :thumbsup:
